name: ReducedIncome

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

variations.context: Planning for a period of reduced income

setting.relationship_dynamic: Partners preparing for a temporary income change
setting.background: They expect lower income for several months

scenario_template.topic: Discussing the expected change in income
scenario_template.note: They estimate how long the reduced-income period may last

scenario_template.topic: Realizing current spending cannot continue unchanged
scenario_template.note: They need to distinguish essential commitments from flexible spending
They ask how to prepare before the income reduction begins

scenario_template.topic: Prioritizing essential expenses and building a cash buffer
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them identify expenses that can be reduced temporarily

scenario_template.topic: Deciding how much savings to reserve for the transition
scenario_template.note: They weigh preserving cash against current savings goals

scenario_template.topic: Adjusting the plan if the reduced-income period lasts longer
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them build checkpoints for reassessment

scenario_template.topic: Agreeing on a temporary spending plan
scenario_template.note: They feel more secure about navigating the transition

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
